name: jira-count-by
description: Count Jira issues from a JQL query by status. Counts only the page fetched (up to maxResults); use jira-issues to see whether more pages exist.
js: const d = r.issues?.nodes ?? r.data?.issues ?? r.issues ?? []; const m = {}; for (const i of d) { const k = i.fields?.status?.name ?? 'unknown'; m[k] = (m[k] || 0) + 1; } return m;
